name: Taking Care Of Widows
overview: Scripture clearly commands believers to show compassion and justice toward widows, forbidding affliction or exploitation of them, as seen in Exodus 22:22 and Deuteronomy 24:17. God's people are instructed to care for the vulnerable among them, including widows, by generosity and protecting their rights, exemplified through the practice of tithing (Deuteronomy 14:28) and open-heartedness toward the poor (Deuteronomy 15:7). The example of Boaz’s kindness in Ruth 2:5 and the call to defend the afflicted in Psalms 82:3 further emphasize the biblical mandate to uphold widows in love and justice.
